parsed.name: WebDAV 临时目录集合
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于 WebDAV 服务器中表示仅保存在内存中的临时目录集合。这些临时目录在真正落盘前用于支持常见的“创建后再重命名/移动”目录创建流程，适合实验数据目录的暂存、属性查询和成员管理。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that represents an in-memory temporary directory collection in a WebDAV server. These temporary directories are used to support the common create-then-rename/move workflow before a directory is materialized on disk, for tasks such as staging experimental data folders, querying properties, and managing members.
